purpose: GEO/SEO baseline for VetAgent. Fixed before the first measurement on 2026-09-15 and not edited after a reading; re-measure with the same list and the same rule.

metric.found: VetAgent is 'found' on a surface for a query when vetagent.dev, github.com/jakegu1/vetagent, or a directory listing page for VetAgent (registry, Glama, Smithery, mcpservers.org, PulseMCP, mcp.so) appears in the top 10 results, or when an AI answer names VetAgent or cites one of those URLs.
metric.headline: Share of the 12 non-branded queries where VetAgent is found, per surface. The 3 branded queries are controls: if VetAgent is not found for its own name, the problem is indexing, not relevance, and the non-branded share cannot be read.
metric.also_recorded: The rank when found; the tools that are named instead, so a later reading can tell 'we rose' from 'the field changed'.
metric.not_a_pass_mark: There is no target. The first reading is a baseline; the comparison is between readings on the same list.

surfaces.web_search: The web search tool available to the measuring session, top 10 results per query. Which engine backs it is not under our control and is recorded as a limit.
surfaces.ai_answers: Answer engines usable without an account (Perplexity, ChatGPT without login), in a clean browser. A surface that demands login or a captcha is recorded as not measurable, never as 'not found'.
surfaces.crawler_access: Whether verified AI crawlers are served or blocked by Cloudflare, read from the zone's settings or its request logs.
